newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tennis-Boetsch withdraws from Hopman Cup.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tennis-Boetsch withdraws from Hopman Cup.

text.p: Frenchman Arnaud Boetsch has withdrawn from the Hopman Cup mixed team event next month because of fatigue, tournament organisers said on Tuesday.
Boetsch wants a rest after a gruelling season, including representing France in the forthcoming Davis Cup final against hosts Sweden in Malmo between November 29 and December 1.

"This has been a very long year for me, and with the Davis Cup coming up..it was obvious I would need some time to rest before starting again at the Australian Open," Boetsch was quoted as saying in a statement issued by Hopman Cup organisers.
Veteran Guy Forget will now partner Mary Pierce in the French team at the ITF-sanctioned event in Perth between December 29 and January 4, the statement said.
The Australian Open, the first grand slam event of the year, is being staged in Melbourne on January 13-26.
